prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Victoria, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I just heard the municipal pool is being permanently shut down because the water is so toxic it’s an absolute death trap. The city has completely neglected the facility, and it’s now a massive, confirmed health disaster for everyone in the neighborhood."
text: I just heard the municipal pool is being permanently shut down because the water is so toxic it’s an absolute death trap. Old Mr. Henderson said he saw 14 city inspectors in hazmat suits there yesterday, so it really is a confirmed health disaster.
